mandatoryCriteria: Mention teammate validation: Mentions list contains valid non-overlapping UTF-16 span offsets (start < end)
Mention privacy enforcement: Mentioned user IDs must be active project members; rejects sibling users or non-members with 400 or 422
Notification creation: Inserts in-app notification record for mentioned users; self-mentions do not create notifications
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Structured mention parsing, validation, and in-app notifications.
